__base__.name: aops-cope
__base__.description: Advisory in-session rule enforcement: a small language model judges each tool call against the three-layer rule set (axioms, project rules, user rules) over the Reflexes evaluator contract.

cope_evaluator_url.title: Evaluator endpoint URL
cope_evaluator_url.description: Full URL of the policy evaluator: a hosted CoPE label API, a self-hosted CoPE server, or a local OpenAI-compatible server. There is no default and no fallback — left blank, cope evaluates nothing.

cope_evaluator_protocol.title: Evaluator protocol
cope_evaluator_protocol.description: Which wire protocol that URL speaks: 'cope' for the CoPE label API, or 'openai' for an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions server. Required alongside the URL; any other value is refused rather than guessed.

cope_evaluator_model.title: Evaluator model
cope_evaluator_model.description: Model identifier sent with each request. Required alongside the URL; there is no default model.

cope_evaluator_api_key.title: Evaluator API key
cope_evaluator_api_key.description: Bearer token for the endpoint. Leave blank for a local server that needs no auth — the Authorization header is then not sent at all.

cope_evaluator_timeout.title: Evaluation timeout (seconds)
cope_evaluator_timeout.description: Seconds allowed for the whole evaluation of one tool call, across all rules — the longest a tool call can be held up. Blank uses the built-in budget.
